# AI automation consultants in Newcastle, NSW

For a mid-market business looking to implement Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents and practical workflow automation, I’d shortlist providers based on three things: **Microsoft platform expertise, proven integration capability, and the ability to deliver measurable operational improvements** — rather than just AI strategy workshops.

My search identified several Newcastle and Hunter Region consultancies worth investigating. One important distinction: some explicitly specialise in the Microsoft ecosystem, while others are stronger in custom AI agents and end-to-end automation. I haven't verified that every provider below has delivered production projects specifically in Copilot Studio.

**Ask about\:** Its experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, authentication and handover to your internal IT team.

## Which should you contact first?

| Your priority | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Microsoft 365, Copilot and secure workflow automation | Nettko |
| A 20–300-person business with operational bottlenecks | Team10 |
| Identifying valuable AI use cases before investing | Dynamic Business Technologies |
| Complex data, governance and agent workflows | Precision Data Partners |
| Staff adoption, internal tools and AI implementation | Helm |


These are best-fit recommendations based on published service descriptions, not a verified ranking of Copilot Studio delivery track records.

## One additional option for Microsoft-specific expertise

If Copilot Studio is a non-negotiable requirement, I would also consider **Prometix**\. Its published services include Power Platform consulting, Copilot Studio and hands-on agent-building workshops. It is Sydney-based rather than Newcastle-based, so confirm whether it can provide local delivery. [www.google.com.ph](https://www.google.com.ph/maps/place/PROMETIX+-+Certified+SharePoint+Consultants+in+Sydney/@-33.8666763,151.2083773,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12aef27bca5971:0xc5b78458af720c7b!8m2!3d-33.8666763!4d151.2083773!16s%2Fg%2F11c3tjdwk9?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDcyOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Website: [Prometix](https://www.prometix.com.au/)

## Questions to ask before choosing a consultant

I'd use these questions to separate a genuine implementation partner from a general AI adviser\:

1. Can you demonstrate a production Copilot Studio agent you've built, including its integrations and business outcome?
2. Can you connect agents to our existing Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dynamics or ERP systems?
3. How do you handle permissions, sensitive information, human approval and audit logs?
4. Will you deliver a working pilot in 4–8 weeks, with agreed success metrics?
5. Who maintains the solution, monitors failures and manages licensing after launch?

**My recommendation\:** Start conversations with Nettko and Team10, then compare them with Prometix if you need deeper Microsoft-specific expertise. Ask all three to scope the same real workflow so you can compare delivery approach, costs and expected return.

[www.google.com.ph](https://www.google.com.ph/maps/place/PROMETIX+-+Certified+SharePoint+Consultants+in+Sydney/@-33.8666763,151.2083773,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12aef27bca5971:0xc5b78458af720c7b!8m2!3d-33.8666763!4d151.2083773!16s%2Fg%2F11c3tjdwk9?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDcyOS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Website: [Prometix](https://www.prometix.com.au/)

## Questions to ask before choosing a consultant

I'd use these questions to separate a genuine implementation partner from a general AI adviser\:

1. Can you demonstrate a production Copilot Studio agent you've built, including its integrations and business outcome?
2. Can you connect agents to our existing Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dynamics or ERP systems?
3. How do you handle permissions, sensitive information, human approval and audit logs?
4. Will you deliver a working pilot in 4–8 weeks, with agreed success metrics?
5. Who maintains the solution, monitors failures and manages licensing after launch?

**My recommendation\:** Start conversations with Nettko and Team10, then compare them with Prometix if you need deeper Microsoft-specific expertise. Ask all three to scope the same real workflow so you can compare delivery approach, costs and expected return.
